description: Build a stable little planet from the visible block order. Every block must settle against the planet or an already placed block under radial gravity.

metadata.notes: Original radial-gravity masonry implementation grounded in TRW-036; visible block placement, radial settling, support contacts, server replay, and exported verification share one contract.

name: Little Planet Mason
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Place every requested masonry block around the little planet so the blocks settle into the marked stable sockets; choose the correct face orientation for each curved support. Use direct dragging and right-click rotation or the visible tray controls as shown. Do not use code, scripts, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, page state, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload, navigation, extensions, or external applications.
